### New

- **Antennae.** A new hat under **Look → Hat**: two thin antennae on top of your head with glowing balls on the ends that gently wobble. With **Glow with the lyrics** on, the balls swell and flare with each new line.
- **Record card.** A new option under **Display → Record card**: a small card in a corner of the screen with a vinyl record that spins while the song plays, the album cover as its label, the song and artist, and a line with the time played and the time left. Under the record, a thin strip shows the line being sung right now, fading in as each new line starts; a line too long for the strip slides along as it is sung, so you can read its end too (switch it off with **Lyric line** if you only want the song). Pick any of the four corners; on a small screen a bottom card moves up so it never covers your hotbar, and a top right card steps down under your potion effect icons. Its two times always add up to the song length, and when a player doesn't say how long the song is, the card leaves out the empty line.
- **Note crosshair.** A new choice under **Look → Crosshair**: a little music note in your lyrics colour, with its round head on the spot you aim at.
- **Leaving.** A new World setting under **Look**: choose how each sung word goes away. Shrink fades it in place like before, Float lifts it up into the sky, Blow carries it off like a leaf in the wind, back the way the line came so it never crosses the words still being sung, Sink lets it drop down, and Dissolve makes its letters wink out one by one in no set order, like the original mod's fading lines.
- **Each line colour.** A new choice under **Look → Colour**: every new lyric line fades into the next of six neon colours (pink, cyan, lilac, mint, amber and blue). The top bar follows along when its accent is set to the lyrics colour. In World, words that are already fading keep the colour they were sung in, so each line stays its own colour as it drifts away.
- **Slide.** A new choice under **Look → Animation** for the Lines layout: the old line slides off to one side as the new one glides in from the other.

### Better looking

- **Even word sizes.** Short and long World words are now closer in size, so little words like "in" and "the" read as easily as the long ones and a line looks even, like the original mod.
- **The word being sung stands out.** In World, a word now eases a little smaller once the next word lands, like the original mod, so the word being sung right now is always the biggest one in the line.
- **Softer fading words.** A World word that has been sung now turns a paler shade of its own colour as it fades, like the original mod, instead of a grey that looked darker than the sky behind it.
- **Calmer lines.** On a sloped or curved flowing line, words now stand mostly upright and step along it like stairs, instead of tilting with the line. Lines read more easily.

### Fixes

- **Band names on the song card.** The song card that floats up when a song starts showed only part of names like "Simon & Garfunkel" or "Tyler, The Creator". Short credits now show in full; only a long list of artists is cut to the first one.
- **Fewer words on top of words.** In a crowded sky, when a new World word finds no clear spot, it now takes the spot least in the way instead of the first one, so it no longer lands right on another word.
- **Long choice rows fit.** A row with many choices, like Animation in Hebrew, could be wider than the settings window and push its own name out of sight. The choices now sit a little closer together when space runs short, so the name and every choice stay visible.
- **No setting that does nothing.** The Animation setting now only shows with the Lines layout. The Arc and World words have their own way of coming in and never used it.
- **Music breaks, not "♪" words.** Lyrics that mark a break with a lone "♪" or a part name like "[Chorus]" now show the usual break between lines instead of floating the note or the label as if it were sung.
- **No stray times in lyrics.** A repeated line written with spaces between its times, like "[00:05] [00:30] …", now shows at both times instead of showing "[00:30]" as part of the words.
- **German words keep pace in capitals.** With Capitals on, a line with "ß" in it no longer lets its later words fall behind the singing, in every layout and in the top bar.
- **Words split where they should.** Lyrics copied from websites sometimes use thin, wide or invisible spaces between words. These now count as normal spaces, so World no longer floats a whole phrase as one long word.
- **Song times read the same everywhere.** On a computer set to Arabic, Persian or another language with its own digits, the Record card times now use plain numbers like the rest of the game.
